title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Chronic Crisis Stream Programme implemented by Christian Aid with local partners ECC-MERU and SARCAF in South Kivu, DRC, aims to meet the complex interconnected needs of crisis- and conflict-affected communities, reduce the risk of violent conflict, foster resilience and reduce vulnerability to the impacts of climate change, through integrated, people-centred approaches which put communities and civil society organisations in the driving seat. The objectives of the grant are to support communties to: (1) respond to humanitarian need, (2a) tackle violence and build peace; (2b) tackle gender-based violence; (3) strengthen resilience; and (4) adapt to climate change. In 2024, 9,908 individuals were successfully reached.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: ZAR. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Humanitarian response
